class.name: OcgAdaptor3dTopoltool
class.brief_description: This class provides a default topological tool, based on the Umin,Vmin,Umax,Vmax of an HSurface from Adaptor3d. All methods and fields may be redefined when inheriting from this class. This class is used to instantiate algorithms as Intersection, outlines,...
class.description: ! This class provides a default topological tool, ! based on the Umin,Vmin,Umax,Vmax of an HSurface from Adaptor3d. ! All methods and fields may be redefined when inheriting from this class. ! This class is used to instantiate algorithms as Intersection, outlines,...

method.name: Orientation_1
method.description: If the function returns the orientation of the arc. If the orientation is FORWARD or REVERSED, the arc is a "real" limit of the surface. If the orientation is INTERNAL or EXTERNAL, the arc is considered as an arc on the surface.

method.name: Orientation_2
method.description: Returns the orientation of the vertex V. The vertex has been found with an exploration on a given arc. The orientation is the orientation of the vertex on this arc.

method.name: Identical
method.description: Returns True if the vertices V1 and V2 are identical. This method does not take the orientation of the vertices in account.

method.name: Has3d
method.description: answers if arcs and vertices may have 3d representations, so that we could use Tol3d and Pnt methods.

method.name: Tol3d_1
method.description: returns 3d tolerance of the arc C

method.name: Tol3d_2
method.description: returns 3d tolerance of the vertex V

method.name: Pnt
method.description: returns 3d point of the vertex V

method.name: NbSamplesU
method.description: compute the sample-points for the intersections algorithms

method.name: NbSamplesV
method.description: compute the sample-points for the intersections algorithms

method.name: NbSamples
method.description: compute the sample-points for the intersections algorithms

method.name: UParameters
method.description: return the set of U parameters on the surface obtained by the method SamplePnts

method.name: VParameters
method.description: return the set of V parameters on the surface obtained by the method SamplePnts

method.name: SamplePnts
method.description: Compute the sample-points for the intersections algorithms by adaptive algorithm for BSpline surfaces. For other surfaces algorithm is the same as in method ComputeSamplePoints(), but only fill arrays of U and V sample parameters;

method.name: BSplSamplePnts
method.description: Compute the sample-points for the intersections algorithms by adaptive algorithm for BSpline surfaces - is used in SamplePnts

method.name: IsUniformSampling
method.description: Returns true if provide uniform sampling of points.
